cases.sentence: ___ об Иисусе распространялся по всей округе.
cases.translation: News about Jesus spread through the whole region.
cases.explain: Слух is the subject of распространялся (was spreading) → nominative.

cases.sentence: А-а-а, что ты хочешь от нас, Иисус из ___?
cases.translation: Ah! What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth?
cases.explain: The preposition из (from/of) takes the genitive → Назарета.

cases.sentence: Иисус приказал ___ покинуть женщину, и та оставила ее.
cases.translation: Jesus commanded the fever to leave the woman, and it left her.
cases.explain: Приказать кому-то (to command someone) puts the one commanded in the dative → горячке.

cases.sentence: Иисус приказал горячке покинуть ___, и та оставила ее.
cases.translation: Jesus commanded the fever to leave the woman, and it left her.
cases.explain: Женщину is the direct object of покинуть (to leave) → accusative.

cases.sentence: Если ты сын Божий, то прикажи этому камню стать ___.
cases.translation: If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.
cases.explain: The verb стать (to become) governs the instrumental → хлебом.

cases.sentence: В ___ был человек, одержимый демоном, нечистым духом.
cases.translation: In the synagogue there was a man possessed by a demon, an unclean spirit.
cases.explain: В (in), marking location, takes the prepositional → синагоге.

reading.ru: Там его сорок дней искушал дьявол.
reading.question: How long was Jesus tempted by the devil in the wilderness?
reading.explain: The devil tempted Jesus in the wilderness for forty days.

reading.ru: Тогда дьявол сказал ему, «Если ты сын Божий, то прикажи этому камню стать хлебом».
reading.question: What was the devil's first temptation of Jesus?
options: To command a stone to become bread
To multiply loaves for the crowd
reading.correct: To command a stone to become bread
reading.explain: The devil told Jesus, if he was the Son of God, to command a stone to become bread.

reading.ru: «Я передам тебе всю их власть и славу, потому что они отданы мне, и я отдаю их кому захочу. Итак, если ты поклонишься мне, все это будет твоим».
reading.question: What did the devil offer Jesus in exchange for worship?
options: Authority and glory over all the kingdoms of the world
reading.correct: Authority and glory over all the kingdoms of the world
reading.explain: The devil offered Jesus all the authority and glory of the kingdoms of the world if he would worship him.

reading.ru: «Если ты сын Божий, — сказал он, — то бросься отсюда вниз, ведь написано же, своим ангелам повелит о тебе охранять тебя,
reading.question: What was the devil's third temptation, at the pinnacle of the temple?
options: To throw himself down from the temple
To turn the temple to gold
To call down fire from heaven
To command the priests to bow
reading.correct: To throw himself down from the temple
reading.explain: At the temple, the devil told Jesus, if he was the Son of God, to throw himself down.

reading.ru: Он развернул его и нашел место, где было написано «Дух Господа на мне, потому что он помазал меня возвещать бедным радостную весть».
reading.question: What passage did Jesus read from the scroll of Isaiah in the synagogue at Nazareth?
options: "The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor"
"In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth"
reading.correct: "The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor"
reading.explain: Jesus unrolled the scroll and read, "The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor."

reading.ru: «Но разве он не сын Иосифа?» — спрашивали они.
reading.question: What question did the people of Nazareth ask about Jesus?
options: Whether he was not just Joseph's son
Whether he had come from Jerusalem
Whether he was a Roman citizen
Whether he had studied under a rabbi
reading.correct: Whether he was not just Joseph's son
reading.explain: The people asked, "Isn't this Joseph's son?"

reading.ru: Но говорю вам истину, ни одного пророка не принимают на его родине.
reading.question: What did Jesus say about prophets in their hometowns?
options: No prophet is accepted in his hometown
Every prophet is honored at home
Prophets should avoid their hometowns entirely
Prophets are only accepted by foreigners
reading.correct: No prophet is accepted in his hometown
reading.explain: Jesus said that truly, no prophet is accepted in his own hometown.

reading.ru: Они вскочили, вытащили Иисуса за пределы города и привели к обрыву горы, на которой был построен город, чтобы сбросить его вниз. Но Иисус прошел сквозь толпу и ушел.
reading.question: How did the people of Nazareth react to Jesus's words, and what happened next?
options: They tried to throw him off a cliff, but he passed through the crowd and left
They welcomed him as their king
They asked him to perform more miracles
reading.correct: They tried to throw him off a cliff, but he passed through the crowd and left
reading.explain: The enraged crowd dragged Jesus to a cliff to throw him down, but he passed through their midst and went away.

reading.question: What did Jesus say to the unclean spirit in the synagogue at Capernaum?
reading.explain: Jesus sternly rebuked the unclean spirit, saying, "Be silent, and come out of him."

reading.ru: Наклонившись над ней, Иисус приказал горячке покинуть женщину, и та оставила ее.
reading.question: How did Jesus heal Simon's mother-in-law?
options: He bent over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her
He sent her to the temple priests
He prayed over her for seven days
reading.correct: He bent over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her
reading.explain: Jesus bent over Simon's mother-in-law, rebuked the fever, and it left her.

reading.ru: «Я должен возвещать радостную весть о Царстве Божьем и в других городах, ведь для этого Я и послан».
reading.question: Why did Jesus leave the crowd that wanted him to stay?
options: He had to preach the good news of God's Kingdom in other towns too, since that was why he was sent
He wanted to visit his mother
reading.correct: He had to preach the good news of God's Kingdom in other towns too, since that was why he was sent
reading.explain: Jesus told them he had to preach the good news of God's Kingdom in other towns too, since that was his purpose.
